import Mathlib

set_option maxHeartbeats 0

open BigOperators Real Nat Topology Rat

theorem algebra_9onxpypzleqsum2onxpy
  (x y z : ℝ)
  (h₀ : 0 < x ∧ 0 < y ∧ 0 < z) :
  9 / (x + y + z) ≤ 2 / (x + y) + 2 / (y + z) + 2 / (z + x) := by
  have h₁ : 0 < x + y := by linarith [h₀.1, h₀.2.1]
  have h₂ : 0 < y + z := by linarith [h₀.2.1, h₀.2.2]
  have h₃ : 0 < z + x := by linarith [h₀.2.2, h₀.1]
  have h₄ : 0 < x + y + z := by linarith [h₀.1, h₀.2.1, h₀.2.2]
  
  -- Use the AM-HM inequality on the three positive numbers (x+y), (y+z), (z+x)
  -- We know that for positive reals a,b,c: (a+b+c)/3 ≥ 3/(1/a + 1/b + 1/c)
  -- Rearranging: 1/a + 1/b + 1/c ≥ 9/(a+b+c)
  have h₅ : 1 / (x + y) + 1 / (y + z) + 1 / (z + x) ≥ 9 / ((x + y) + (y + z) + (z + x)) := by
    have h₅₁ : 0 < x + y := by linarith
    have h₅₂ : 0 < y + z := by linarith
    have h₅₃ : 0 < z + x := by linarith
    -- Apply the AM-HM inequality: sum of reciprocals ≥ 9/sum
    field_simp [h₅₁.ne', h₅₂.ne', h₅₃.ne']
    rw [div_le_div_iff (by positivity) (by positivity)]
    nlinarith [sq_nonneg (x + y - (y + z)), sq_nonneg (y + z - (z + x)), 
               sq_nonneg (z + x - (x + y))]
  
  -- Simplify the right side of h₅
  have h₆ : (x + y) + (y + z) + (z + x) = 2 * (x + y + z) := by ring
  rw [h₆] at h₅
  
  -- Multiply both sides by 2 to get the desired inequality
  have h₇ : 2 / (x + y) + 2 / (y + z) + 2 / (z + x) ≥ 18 / (2 * (x + y + z)) := by
    calc
      2 / (x + y) + 2 / (y + z) + 2 / (z + x) = 2 * (1 / (x + y) + 1 / (y + z) + 1 / (z + x)) := by ring
      _ ≥ 2 * (9 / (2 * (x + y + z))) := by gcongr
      _ = 18 / (2 * (x + y + z)) := by ring
  
  -- Simplify the final expression
  have h₈ : 18 / (2 * (x + y + z)) = 9 / (x + y + z) := by
    field_simp [h₄.ne']
    <;> ring
    <;> field_simp [h₄.ne']
    <;> ring
  
  linarith
